home.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: TrainUp page Open Graph / SEO share image. Landscape 1200:630 composition. Large clean modern sans-serif exact text "TrainUp" on the left, smaller exact page label below. Page-specific visual on the right. Generous margins, all content within central 85 percent. Scene: A welcoming adult in coral sportswear preparing a teal mat and two small dumbbells in a simple warm cream training room, accompanied by a minimal weekly calendar with teal checkmarks. The TrainUp wordmark must be bold rounded modern sans-serif, teal Train and coral Up. No slogan.

exercises.template: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: TrainUp exercise catalog illustration. Create a single polished raster illustration of the exercise {{id}} ({{name}}). Landscape 16:10 composition. One adult of realistic everyday athletic proportions in coral #d6410f sportswear and navy trousers, on a warm cream #fff8f0 studio background, teal #0b6b5f mat where floor contact is needed, equipment rendered navy and teal. Refined editorial illustration with soft shading and clean anatomically plausible forms. Show ONE clear representative pose, entire body and required equipment in frame, centered with generous 15 percent margins, side or three-quarter view chosen to clearly show the movement. Follow this catalog movement description: {{steps}} Technique constraints: {{techniqueNotes}} No text, no labels, no inset panels, no decorative extra equipment, no anatomical overlays, no watermark. For dynamic exercise show a single identifiable midpoint. Correct number of limbs and natural joints. Educational illustration to accompany existing written instructions.
exercises.parameterExpansion: Use id, name, steps.join(' ') and techniqueNotes.join(' ') from each record. Save to src/assets/exercises/{id}.jpg.

encoding: JPEG quality 85, fit with cream padding; originals preserved in Codex generated_images.
